prompt:
Subject:
Amber Morning Preparation

Main Subject:
An indoor portrait capturing a single adult woman sitting on an off-white bed, shown from her head down to her bent legs. She occupies the center of the frame, with her pale beige satin slip dress catching the morning light.

Person/Expression:
A slightly elongated oval face with a small chin, dark brown almond-shaped eyes, thin natural eyebrows, a small nose, and full dusty pink lips. Her face is tilted toward the bottom left of the frame, with her gaze also dropped to the bottom left, and a quiet expression with closed lips. Long dark brown hair parted near the center, leaving thin bangs and fine strands falling along the cheeks, flowing naturally from shoulders to back. Light eye makeup, soft coral blush, and warm, smooth skin.

Clothing/Pose:
A pale champagne beige above-the-knee satin slip dress. Features ultra-thin shoulder straps, a deep V-neck, delicate matching floral lace at the bust and hem, and loose draping transitioning below the bust. Sitting on the bed with both knees bent, her left thigh toward the front and her right leg folded under her body. Her left hand is placed on the bedding to her left, while her right arm is placed behind her to support her upper body, with shoulders slightly shrugged.

Background/Lighting:
Off-white duvet and pillows, with a beige upholstered headboard behind. To the right of the screen is a small wooden side table and a transparent glass bottle with pale dried flowers. The window at the top right has white sheer curtains and beige thick curtains. Soft diffused morning light from the window on the right acts as the primary light source, warmly illuminating her cheeks, bust, satin, and thighs, while casting gentle shadows to the left.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 14:19 aspect ratio. A close-up portrait taken from a camera slightly above bed height at a very light high-angle view. The person is placed in the center with a small amount of headroom, capturing from the left hand to the vicinity of the right toes. The toes at the right edge are naturally cropped, with focus on the face and upper body, while the background vase is softly blurred with a shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style:
Warm-toned photorealistic live-action photograph. Renders the smooth luster of satin, lace details, bedding wrinkles, and skin and hair with high definition and naturalness. A quiet and intimate morning atmosphere centered on beige, off-white, and amber tones.

Negative:
Do not change to a white cotton dress; do not use a straight-ahead gaze or standing pose.
